a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of running the generator to 8 first means we'll very likely both be caught with empty units. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than gamble on that, so I'm telling you now instead of surprising you. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4 too. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you short, and I'm sorry. If we get another round, I'll operate every round from here on and won't take anything more, so all the generator output goes to you.
